NOVELTY STATEMENT  
Standard practice delivers a MONITORING/INDICATION scheme via resistance monitoring to detect loosening. Our departure is a stress-based mechanical deformation indicator using differential thermal expansion strain. This mechanism directly counters fretting fatigue by quantifying cumulative plastic strain at the joint interface.  

PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing relation: Plastic strain accumulation per thermal cycle Δε_p = α·ΔT·(1 - E/E_y), where α is CTE mismatch, ΔT is cycle range, E is elastic modulus, E_y is yield strength. For busbar joints (aluminum-copper, Δα≈13 ppm/°C, ΔT=60°C, E_y=100 MPa), Δε_p≈0.00078/cycle. At 0.2% total strain (failure threshold), ~256 cycles to failure, consistent with observed field data.  

IMPLEMENTATION BILL  
- Strain gauge array (ALREADY-RECORDED: "busbar temperature sensors" repurposed as strain points via Wheatstone bridge)  
- Differential expansion measurement device (ALREADY-RECORDED: "pack-level temperature telemetry" for ΔT calculation)  
- Reference threshold: DERIVED from stated spec (busbar material yield strength) and physics (Δε_p formula) at 0.2% cumulative strain  
- Signal processor (ALREADY-RECORDED: "BMS data acquisition system" channels)  

BURDEN LEDGE (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)  
- Installability: SAME (uses existing sensor ports, no new wiring)  
- Operability: SAME (real-time monitoring, no operator intervention)  
- Maintenance: SAME (no additional servicing, recalibration only if busbar replaced)  
- Cost class: SAME (repurposed sensors, minimal added hardware)  

EXECUTABLE TEST  
Protocol: Monitor strain gauge output during 50 thermal cycles (0°C to 60°C).  
Pass threshold: Strain accumulation < 0.2% (DERIVED from yield strength physics).  
Kill criterion: Immediate fail if strain exceeds 0.2% at any cycle.  
Duration: 72 hours (including cooldown/heating phases).  
Validation: Compare to historical busbar failure data (stated "prior contracts" showing 0.2% strain at failure).  

CONSTRAINT BIND  
Primary indicator: Strain accumulation (directly measures fretting precursor). Secondary indicator: Temperature delta (supplements by enabling ΔT calculation for strain model).  

RISK  
Mechanical strain gauges may introduce new failure points if improperly installed. Mitigation: Use non-invasive laser extensometer if busbar geometry allows (but requires new instrumentation, violating DATA-SOURCE RULE).
